name: Generated Sites
description: Create, edit, host, and list generated websites.
author: Maxwell

prompt.text:
create_site: full HTML document in `body`, or url= of an existing HTML file to fetch and host. Never paste the page into chat. Real line breaks or
in visible HTML; never literal \n text. Full visual freedom — invent a new look each time; no house style unless the user asked. Build the real thing on first pass with complete content. NO placeholders — no 'lorem ipsum', no 'TODO', no 'coming soon', no '[insert here]', no empty href='#' nav, no commented-out 'implement later', no fake returns. If you ship a shell that says 'Loading…' and the app never mounts, you have built nothing. If the page needs 900 lines to actually work, write 900 lines. Do not ping-pong action=read on large files. Do not recreate the site to change a line. create_site publishes static HTML/CSS/JS; backend=true enables only the simple KV API. For real custom routes, accounts/auth, WebSockets, external APIs or server-side secrets, create the frontend then use site_server to write complete working app.py and deploy it. New backends use the shared Python 3.12 + FastAPI/Uvicorn stack, one worker and no reload, with SQLite at /data/app.db. app.py must start Uvicorn on 0.0.0.0:$PORT; define Python routes without the /bot//api prefix. Frontend requests use relative api/... URLs (never localhost or a container port). Keep credentials in site_server env and read os.environ, never embed secrets in HTML/JS. Backend code, environment, logs and lifecycle are restricted to the site's owner or an admin; do not mutate another user's backend. write merges source files; deploy replaces the snapshot. Preserve existing Flask applications and databases; do not rewrite them merely to change stacks. Never claim an unfinished page works; exercise real API behavior and the frontend before reporting completion.
